title: Do the Right Thing, Just Debias! Multi-Category Bias Mitigation Using LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to rewrite biased source sentences into debiased target sentences, measured by comparing generated outputs against parallel unbiased reference sentences using reference-based metrics (BLEU, METEOR, BERTScore), a reference-free linguistic quality metric (GRUEN), and human evaluation.
